name: Ghana

instruments.name: Banks and Specialised Deposit-Taking Institutions Act, 2016 (Act 930)

facet_hints.registration: Ghana operates a data controller registration regime with the Data Protection Commission; check whether registration and renewal obligations bite, and what the fee schedule and validity period currently are.
facet_hints.personal_data: Act 843 defines personal data and the data protection principles; confirm the eight principles as enacted and how they map to processing conditions.
facet_hints.special_categories: Act 843 treats certain data as special personal data; the Ghana Card number (NIA) and biometric identifiers are high-sensitivity in practice.
facet_hints.cross_border: Check the conditions Act 843 places on transferring personal data outside Ghana and whether the Commission has issued guidance or a whitelist.
facet_hints.breach_notification: Confirm whether Act 843 imposes a notification duty, to whom, and in what period; check separately whether the Cybersecurity Act 1038 imposes incident reporting for critical information infrastructure.
facet_hints.data_subject_rights: Access, correction, prevention of processing, and the fee and response-time limits attached to each.
facet_hints.enforcement: Search for enforcement notices, prosecutions and published decisions by the Data Protection Commission, and any court decisions applying Act 843.

seed_obligations.title: Register as a data controller with the Data Protection Commission
applies_when: processes personal data of individuals in Ghana
testable_as: evidence of a current Data Protection Commission registration certificate
a renewal date tracked somewhere the team will see it
seed_obligations.note: Ghana's registration regime is unusual among the launch regions and is frequently missed by startups. Retrieval must confirm the current provision, fee, and validity period before this is reported.

seed_obligations.title: Process personal data in accordance with the statutory principles
testable_as: a stated lawful basis per processing purpose
collection limited to the stated purpose
a retention period and a deletion path per data category

seed_obligations.title: Apply appropriate security safeguards to personal data
testable_as: encryption in transit and at rest for special personal data
access control on tables holding personal data
no credentials in client bundles or version control

seed_obligations.title: Meet the conditions for processing personal data outside Ghana
applies_when: personal data of Ghanaian data subjects is processed outside Ghana
an inference or hosting vendor is located outside Ghana
testable_as: a documented transfer basis for each foreign vendor receiving personal data
a data processing agreement with each foreign processor

seed_obligations.provision: Ghana Card / national identification number handling
seed_obligations.title: Handle Ghana Card numbers as high-sensitivity identifiers
applies_when: stores or transmits a Ghana Card number
testable_as: the column is not returned by default in list endpoints
the value is not written to application logs

notes: Ghana is a launch-depth pack. Every obligation above is a retrieval target, not a finding: the corpus phase must confirm each provision number, its current text, and any penalty from a primary source before it can be reported.
